posts.text: Good lord have mercy. @umichbball is kicking @ArizonaMBB’s ass. Superior guard play. Superior shooting.  Superior Toughness inside and out. This is pure domination. I honestly can’t believe how lopsided this is. Arizona doesn’t look like they belong on the same court. And Burries and Bradley look completely outshined. @umichbball is DESTROYING them right now. Boy…was I wrong about this team.

Keep Educating us bro. Keep Educating us:
 instagram.com/reel/DWkKyfGjE…

Damn Right! He should be sorry! We move on!

Look for yourself. Can’t believe Geno did this. Couldn’t take losing to Dawn Staley. Simply and plain. Horrible, horrible look for him. Straight B…. Move:

ctinsider.com/sports/uconn-w…

That was some straight B.S. from the GREAT Geno Auriemma. Never — ever — thought I’d see the day when the greatest woman’s college coach in history would go down so CLASSLESSLY!!! Horrible look, and should be called out for it. He got OUTCOACHED. Plain and simple. And gets in her face like she did something wrong to him instead of being gracious. Had Dawn Staley acted like that we would be all over her. #HorribleGENO!
